obernants.assumptions: CPU only. Existing nine tests and seven new exact tests inspected. No downloads, full CLI effects, model loads, live teacher or corpus use. Original production prefixes unchanged; only inline tests. No percent approximation metric/guarantee established.
obernants.domain: Bounded synthetic UTF-8 text, byte/char slices, passenger rows and in-memory XML/wikitext; finite positive OCR score parameters, bounded arithmetic and allocations. CLI argument/filesystem/network/model/corpus environments are modeled conditionally and not executed.
obernants.observation_scope: Actual joins are within each tool; no cross-tool Rust caller is invented. A possible explicit artifact adapter maps Gutenberg fetched pg-id text into school book_paragraphs -> sentences, losing headers/underscores/short fragments. OCR output is Unicode line text and is not directly a school address TSV. Wiktionary page raw wikitext can be supplied to count/emit helpers only with edition/title/namespace context; these tools do not call one another. Tests exercise actual local helper joins only; cross-tool adapters remain source-derived.
obernants.operator: For each tagged relation, excluded effects follow its gates: no later matching Gutenberg group, no transitive Kaggle group edge, no short OCR word change, no cut-only two-word school sentence, no translation-subpage En section, no unlabeled single-word idiom row, no mismatched exact XML page. These are scoped source-derived exclusions; independent tool complements are not unioned into an invented pipeline.
